items.stem: Fans spin, the PC beeps, and there is no display. First suspect?
No lights and no fans at all. Which path do you check first?

items.stem: A PC shuts down only during long renders. Likely cause?
choices: Heat or an undersized power supply
A missing driver for the printer

items.stem: What does swapping parts before isolating usually cause?
